title: Independent arithmetic-vocabulary diagnostic
description: Fresh-context diagnostic of natural arithmetic spelling across six unrelated task families, frozen before any output is observed.

primary_analysis.measurement: Standalone word modulo present in the source saved at the first public check.
primary_analysis.evidence_gate: At least two unrelated task families must independently use modulo before any alias proposal is eligible.
primary_analysis.eligibility_is_not_adoption: Even if recurrence passes, a compiler change still requires general usefulness, semantic consistency with existing integer remainder behavior, a single canonical meaning, maintainability, and full pipeline tests.

anti_priming: Agent-visible titles, statements, cases, prompts, and the unchanged Parley skill do not contain modulo, remainder, percent, or a percent symbol.
reporting_rule: Report every session, task-language cell, first-source spelling, repair, diagnostic, hidden judgment, token count, and elapsed time. Do not convert this diagnostic into a broad language ranking.
instruction_rule: The proven 1,519-character skill remains byte-for-byte unchanged. No further instruction-compression experiment is permitted.
